title: Kissed silky hangover-cure Indian Duck-confit-leg Skillet
description: A rich and comforting Indian-inspired skillet dish, ideal for a post-party breakfast or brunch. Featuring tender duck confit leg, fluffy basmati rice, and a silky spice-infused sauce.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of ghee in a large cast-iron skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, carrot, and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger, cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cumin seeds, coriander powder, turmeric powder, and red chili powder, cook for 1 minute, until the spices are fragrant.
Add the duck confit leg, cook for 2-3 minutes, until the skin is crispy.
Add the chopped cilantro, salt, and cook for 1 minute, until the flavors are combined.
Add the uncooked basmati rice, stir to coat with the spice-infused oil, and cook for 1-2 minutes, until the rice is lightly toasted.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and cook at 400°F (200°C) for 20-25 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the duck is heated through.
Remove the skillet from the oven, stir in the remaining 1 tablespoon of ghee, and serve hot.
